subQuests.subQuestName: Go to Yashiori Island to search for Arataki Itto
Use Elemental Sight to chase the tracks

120252001.text: Please, you gotta believe me! Uncle Itto didn't do anything wrong, he's not a bad guy!

120252002.text: I'll take care of Daisuke. No need to worry, dear. Everything will be fine.

120250101.text: Wait, could that be him? Is that Arataki Itto?

120250102.text: He doesn't seem to be looking this way. Perfect, let's try the beans Detective Sango gave us.

120250103.text: It'll save a lot of hassle if we can avoid a fight.

subQuests.subQuestName: Hit Arataki Itto with the beans

120250301.text: By the way, Paimon's curious... What kind of game is beetle fighting?

120250302.text: You guys have seen Onikabuto out in the wild, right? Even though they might look menacing on the outside, they're big softies on the inside. Most of the time they just sit there doing nothing.

120250303.text: But let me tell ya, once the Onikabuto start fighting, they won't let anything get in their way!

120250304.text: The grand game of beetle fighting is a match where your beetle tries to flip the other beetle onto its back.

120250307.text: Hey, it's not just some kids game, okay? It's way deeper than you think!

120250308.text: I have taken part in more beetle fights than you would believe. At least 800 — I may have even crossed the thousand mark by this point. Anyway, after a while, you can tell a beetle's fighting potential just by looking at its shape, size, and the patterns on its body.

120250309.text: But it's not just about all the physical stuff, oh no! Your Onikabuto's gotta be in the right headspace as well. If it's not up for a fight or doesn't have the guts, then it's game over.

120250310.text: Haha! Boy, are you two lucky you ran into me. When it comes to beetles, I'm the expert that the experts go to! I'll show you all you need to know.

120250311.text: But, we're not the ones that will be playing... We're just here to keep an eye on you.

120250313.text: Anyway, not a problem! You two might think that I'm just tooting my own horns here, but just you wait... I'll make you a beetle expert in no time!

120250314.text: And by the way, that kid has one tough beetle, we can't underestimate it. We have to find a real lean mean beetle warrior.

120250315.text: Okay, he's not the sharpest horn on the oni...

120250317.text: There. Let's head to that hill. I'll bet my bottom Mora we're gonna find some major-league Onikabuto hiding out there.

120250203.text: What should we do? Paimon didn't think he'd react this badly!

120250204.text: D—Don't be alarmed... It's just my allergies acting up... I've got it under control!

120250205.text: It's alright, I got this, just gotta tough it out. I can take it... I can take it...

120250206.text: Ah! Who am I kidding! *coughing* I gotta catch my breath here! *coughing* Whatever it is you want, it's gonna have to wait! I need a moment...

120250207.text: Ahh, whew... that's better. That sure took a lot out of me, though...

120250208.text: Hey, why'd you have to be so mean, huh!? Surprise-attacking me like that!

120250210.text: Oh, I get it. So you're here to bring me in. How in the world did you find me all the way out here?

120250213.text: Heh, well, whatever... If you think I'm going back with you, you can forget it. I'd walk away if I were you.

120250214.text: I pack a mean punch, you know. I don't want to hurt any regular folks like you.

120250215.text: That's pretty big talk considering all the beans we have.

120250216.text: You're the one behind the robbery and the missing people, aren't you?

120250217.text: Yep, that's right. Me! All by myself. Nobody else.

120250218.text: As boss of the Arataki Gang, I gotta nab a little food and drink when we're running low. That's only natural, right?

120250219.text: Yeah, but nabbing people? That's taking it a bit far, don't ya think?

120250220.text: Uh... not when their families will pay good Mora to see them again! Easy pickings.

120250221.text: And the extra Mora means I can... uh, give some to my gang to spend on themselves!

120250212.text: Hey, hey, take it easy... just stop with the beans, okay. So you're here to bring me in. How in the world did you find me all the way out here, anyway?

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Onikabuto capture spot

120250501.text: Finally! You're back! Can we start our beetle fight now?

120250502.text: Yeah, sure thing, buddy! But you'd better watch out, I brought a real winner back this time.

120250503.text: Don't worry, I'm not scared of your beetle. Go, go, Stripy Ghost!

120250504.text: I've got this fight in the bag! Let's go, Nimble Ninja!

120250505.text: Huh? When did you come up with that name?

120250506.text: C'mon, you can take 'im, little guy!

120250508.text: Ah, no!!! My little Nimble Ninja!

120250509.text: Hah! Looks like I win again!

120250510.text: Dang it, that's my seventh loss in a row!

120250513.text: Hee-hee, Stripy Ghost is invincible. Even Uncle Itto can't beat him!

120250514.text: I won't forget this! I'll beat you next time, I swear!

120250515.text: Alright, Paimon, you're up. Time to give Crimson Cyclone a shot, maybe it'll end this losing streak of mine.

120250518.text: Whoa! That one looks ultra strong!

120250519.text: But it's still no match for you, Stripy!

120250520.text: Hehe! Alright little guy, use your Super Paimon Tornado!

120250522.text: No, I can't believe it... I lost.

120250523.text: Yay, we won! Hah, Paimon knew Crimson Cyclone would be the best!

120250524.text: Boy, did that one put up a fight. It wiped the floor with Stripy Ghost...

120250525.text: Heh, I know a real beetle trainer when I see one. Way to kick some beetle butt, partner!

120250526.text: Hee-hee, see? Paimon's got real talent! Of course, Crimson Cyclone has to take some of the credit too...

120250527.text: Why don't we let Daisuke keep Crimson Cyclone?

120250528.text: Oh right, yeah, now that the beetle fighting's over and all...

120250531.text: Huh, for me? You're really giving it to me?

120250532.text: Go ahead, take it, Daisuke. When we finally get back to the city, you can show it off to all your friends.

120250533.text: But... will we ever be able to go back?

120250534.text: Of course we will, trust me. I never go back on my word!

120250535.text: Anyway, I got some things I gotta discuss with my friends here. Go play with Granny for a while, would ya? There's a good boy!

120250536.text: Good, the kid doesn't suspect a thing...

120250537.text: You're from the Tenryou Commission, aren't you? I bet you're here to capture Uncle Itto.

120250539.text: Hey! Didn't I tell ya? They're my friends! ...Uh, in fact, they're in the gang. We're practically family!

120250540.text: That's not true! I already know everyone in your little gang, but I've never seen these two before!

120250541.text: Uncle Itto didn't do anything wrong, don't take him away!

120250542.text: And not only did he not do anything wrong, he also saved my life! He's not a bad guy!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the tree where the Onikabuto reside

120250701.text: Thanks for your patronage and good luck!

120250702.text: Don't forget to come with a bigger budget next time.

subQuests.subQuestName: Check the area where lightning struck
Leap off the gorge to look for Onikabuto

120250401.text: This is the one, this is the one! Hahaha! See? As long as you're in my company, you're guaranteed to find yourself an Onikabuto.

120250404.text: Yeah, it's on the smaller side. But size isn't everything in a beetle fight.

120250405.text: But you said earlier that size matters...

120250406.text: Just let the expert explain, okay? What smaller beetles lack in strength they make up for in agility. They usually got a whole bunch o' sick moves just ready to whip out when the right moment comes.

120250407.text: Sure, but it doesn't seem to be very energetic, either.

120250408.text: Listen, you can never see a beetle's true energy until it's in the ring.

120250409.text: It might look a bit young and docile, but that's got its advantages. Haven't you ever heard the saying, "Don't judge a book by its cover"?

120250410.text: Young beetles that have never fought before always go all out in their first fight. Older beetles that have already been through the wars tend to just cower in the corner the moment they see a strong opponent.

120250411.text: I was hoping we'd catch a larger beetle.

120250412.text: Hey, didn't I say not to worry! C'mon, just have a little faith, would ya? My experience is telling me that this Onikabuto was spawned to be a champion.

120250414.text: Right here! Look what Paimon found!

120250415.text: If we're gonna battle some beetles, then Paimon wants in! It's not like we have anything else to do... When you hopped down, Paimon flew off somewhere else nearby and found this one.

120250416.text: Whaddya think, Itto? It's big and strong and looks like a real fighter. It matches everything you said about a good fighter beetle!

120250417.text: Bet the one you guys found must be way, way...

120250419.text: Oh uh... Heh. You got some experience catching beetles too, huh?

120250420.text: Nope, this is the first one Paimon's ever caught!

120250421.text: Well, looks like you've got a real knack for this. You'll be a fellow beetle fighting expert in no time! I mean, not as good as me, but still.

120250422.text: Oh... so overall not that good, then.

120250423.text: Uh anyway, great! With both your beetle and mine, I can tell this'll finally be the one! This time, I'm gonna win for sure!

120250424.text: "This'll finally be the one"? ...You've never won before?

120250425.text: Well, ahem... Y'know, that's just life, man. There are so many people in this world who are talented... and passionate... but it's no guarantee that things will go their way.

120250426.text: So many unrelated things have to come together at once in just the right way to make victory happen. There's this word that really sums it up nicely, actually. It's, uh, "co-incidence"!

120250427.text: As in, pure luck...? Guess it makes no difference whether we have Paimon's beetle or not, then. Might as well just...

120250428.text: Whoa whoa whoa, hey! Hehe, let's not do anything rash here!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go have a bug battle with Daisuke and Itto
Learn about the Oni race's past from Itto

120250601.text: I'll be honest with you. This thing the Tenryou Commission is investigating, with someone going around taking people and their possessions... It wasn't me. Any of it.

120250602.text: I have my own reasons for lying about it, and I really didn't want to get innocent people caught up in this while I'm still trying to solve the real problem here.

120250603.text: I'm the same as you. I just wanna avoid conflict at all costs... But it's just not worth it if someone gets hurt.

120250604.text: So why in the world would you say that you're the culprit?

120250605.text: *sigh* Maybe you don't know because you're outlanders... It all started a long, long time ago with the story of the crimson oni and the blue oni...

120250606.text: Hold on a second, if you're talking about that fairytale, we've heard that one already.

120250607.text: Oh, so you already know. Well, that makes things a whole lot easier.

120250608.text: So... is the story from the fairytale really true?

120250609.text: Everything about the fate of the oni is true. The blue oni chose exile, and the crimson oni stayed behind.

120250610.text: But the other details aren't historically accurate. Fairytales are nice stories, but there's something they leave out... it's a little thing called the cold, hard truth.

120250611.text: The Inazuma of long ago was a dangerous place. If you wanted the Raiden Shogun's protection, you had to have a good relationship with the humans.

120250612.text: The oni are a proud kind, so it wasn't easy for them to ask others for acceptance. Over time, the oni eventually split into two factions.

120250613.text: The crimson oni were friendly with the humans, but the blue oni, they were more stubborn and insisted on keeping to their own.

120250614.text: Paimon thought you were two different species. So really, you're all one family?

120250615.text: Yep, that's right. There's no real difference between us. We just paint our horns different colors to show which side we belong to.

120250616.text: So why did the blue oni choose to exile themselves?

120250617.text: Because humans were still wary of oni at the time.

120250618.text: The crimson oni always hoped to find a way to live in peace with the humans, but the blue oni kept clashing with them.

120250619.text: Humans didn't see a difference between crimson and blue oni. All they knew was that oni were hard to get along with.

120250620.text: If things were to continue that way, the oni were never going to get along with humans. And so, the most revered leaders of the crimson and blue oni decided to resolve it once and for all.

120250621.text: Over drinks, they swore an oath. The blue oni would play the role of evil oni to help the crimson oni integrate into human society. But the blue oni's leader gave two conditions.

120250623.text: First, the oni must abandon any prejudice they held against humanity. Every oni was to accept humans in their heart before the humans accepted them. Oni were not to use their strength to mistreat humans but also were not to stand for mistreatment against themselves.

120250624.text: Second, the crimson oni were to integrate with human society — but not by trying to please the humans. The oni were to embrace their own honest characters, surging tempers, and awesome strength to win respect from humans.

120250625.text: In other words, they were to carry on the oni bloodline while also protecting our oni pride.

120250627.text: After choosing exile, the number of blue oni began to dwindle, until they eventually disappeared altogether.

120250628.text: Since I first heard the story of the blue and crimson oni as a kid, I've heard it countless times in my life... Not once did I ever imagine that the blue oni clan had actually survived...

120250629.text: So you're saying the real culprit was a descendant of the blue oni?

120250630.text: That's right. Most people don't pay attention to the color of an oni's horns. They probably don't even know that blue oni exist.

120250631.text: But nothing gets by the Arataki Gang. At the scene of the crime, they saw an oni with different color horns than mine.

120250632.text: Still, it'd be strange if the culprit really was a descendant of the blue oni. I can't bring myself to accept it.

120250633.text: Because the blue oni also value their own pride?

120250634.text: Exactly! They would give up their life before abandoning their pride.

120250635.text: I have always respected the blue oni for the sacrifice they made, and I know the aspirations my ancestors had for the future of all oni.

120250636.text: Our pride does not allow for any wrongdoing. You don't steal from other people, you don't harm other people, period!

120250637.text: My guess is that the blue oni was tricked or forced into it somehow. But I don't have any evidence...

120250638.text: So you're trying to buy more time?

120250639.text: That's right. If I didn't step in, then the Tenryou Commission would've definitely caught them by now.

120250640.text: But what does Daisuke have to do with any of this? He said that you saved him, so he knows your story, right?

120250641.text: He was the one I managed to save from the ronin after I sent them running from the scene.

120250642.text: He was off playing somewhere when they came by and ransacked his house. By the time he came back, his parents had been taken.

120250643.text: The whole reason I'm in this is to help this kid find his mom and dad again.

120250646.text: I never wanted to tell you any of this... Heh, my original plan was to knock you both out and take my family to hide somewhere else.

120250647.text: There's more to this than just one blue oni — there's a dangerous group behind everything that's been going on. So I didn't want to get anyone else caught up in this mess.

120250648.text: That's everything, the whole story. If you still don't believe me and wanna drag me back to Inazuma City, then I'm going to fight you with all I've got.

120250649.text: But if you're willing to believe me, then please. Give me a little time. Once I find the blue oni, I'll turn the both of us in.

120251001.text: Did you catch a beetle yet?

120251002.text: If you didn't catch one, then get back out there and keep looking. I've been waiting for ages!

120251101.text: Don't worry about us, Itto. Just go on and do what you need to do.

120259901.text: According to Detective Sango, Itto should be somewhere around here.

120259902.text: Katheryne mentioned that he has a Vision. Why not see if you can track him down using Elemental Sight?

120259903.text: Look! Footprints! Let's see where they lead.

120259904.text: Hmm, there's a camp here, but nothing stands out as particularly noteworthy...

120259906.text: There are more footprints here. He should be just up ahead!

120259908.text: Ugh, for crying out loud, this'd better not scare off all the beetles...

120259910.text: Let's hop down from here and take a look. My gut's tellin' me that there's a king-size beetle just below. Beefy beetle king, here we come!

120259911.text: Look, you see all those purple things? It's a whole pile of Onikabuto! Now that's what I'm talking about!
